_partNote: Four of these classes name an effect rather than a thing, so each prompt draws the characteristic hardware instead of the engagement: no beams, jamming cones, flight paths or explosions anywhere. The seven are separated by silhouette rather than by detail, since they render about 74px tall: a tall tripod-and-drum (1), a rifle-shaped handheld unit (2), a fork-mounted barrel with one big round window (3), short fat cartridges (4), one long thin finned tube (5), a flat square of coarse mesh (6), and a blunt rectangular pod (7). The two that could still collide are 4 and 5, both cylinders, so the cartridges are explicitly stubby and upright and the missile is explicitly long, thin and lying down.

partPrompts.1: A small surveillance radar head on a tripod: a squat drum-shaped unit sitting horizontally on top of a slender vertical post that stands on three splayed legs, the drum's front face flat and plain with a shallow rim around it. One tall thin silhouette, no dish, no vehicle, no cables and no operator.
partPrompts.2: A handheld directional jammer shaped like a rifle, standing alone on a flat surface seen three-quarter: a shoulder stock and pistol grip at the back, a straight body, and a flat rectangular antenna panel standing upright at the front end with a coarse grid of about four by three square patches on its face. One object, no person holding it, no tripod, no beam and no target.
partPrompts.3: A laser beam director head carried in a fork mount: a short thick cylindrical barrel lying horizontally, one large flat circular window filling its whole front face, held between the two arms of a U-shaped yoke that stands on a low round pedestal. One bold object, no beam, no light rays, no target, no dish and no antennas.
partPrompts.4: A single large cannon cartridge standing upright on a flat surface: a fat cylindrical case with a rim at its base, stepping in at a shoulder to a shorter blunt-nosed projectile on top. Well separated to one side lies a second identical cartridge on its side. Short and stubby rather than slender, no fins, no belt links, no gun and no launcher.
partPrompts.5: A slender interceptor missile lying horizontally on a flat surface: one long thin tube with a pointed conical nose at one end, four cruciform tail fins at the other, and four much smaller fins near the nose. Long and thin, clearly not a stubby cartridge; no launcher, no rail, no tube, no exhaust and no flight path.
partPrompts.6: A square panel of coarse open netting lying flat and slightly rumpled, only about five large square openings across so the mesh reads clearly at small size, with a small heavy ball weight at each of its four corners. One object, coarse and open, no fine mesh, no frame, no posts, no launcher and no drone.
partPrompts.7: An aircraft jamming pod resting on a flat surface: a boxy rectangular body with flat vertical sides and blunt rounded ends, a short flat mounting lug on top, and two low blade antennas standing up from the top face behind the lug. Boxy and blunt rather than slender and pointed, no fins, no wings, no aircraft and no radiating waves.
